title: Modulation and Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{−1,1\\}$. Multiplying $f$ pointwise by the parity character on $S$ makes its Fourier coefficient at the empty set equal to the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
$f$ maps the sign cube to signs
